Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up — SOC 2 artifacts we need

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the demo today — team appreciated the latency numbers and the canary/fallback discussion. Quick recap and asks from our side so we can slot this into our procurement calendar:  

- We need a completed SOC 2 questionnaire and a prioritized evidence list you can provide for our security team (controls mapping + owners).
- Target is to finish security review and evidence intake by May 18 so we can clear vendor onboarding ahead of our June board cutoff.
- Please call out any items that require on-prem access, cross-account logs, or signed agreements (NDA/BAA).

Attaching the questionnaire template our compliance team uses (FinnovA-SOC2-Questionnaire-v1.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood will supply: 1) a single evidence bundle, 2) per-control evidence owners, and 3) estimated delivery dates?

Thanks — cc'ing procurement (Carlos) who will own timelines.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Vendor Risk
FinnovA Finance

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — SOC 2 artifacts we need

Hi Elena — great to meet the team yesterday and appreciate the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we will provide a mapped questionnaire response, an evidence index with owners, and a delivery plan tied to MAP milestones.

I attached a first-pass MAP draft and a CSV evidence-index template for your review (Redwood-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, evidence-index-template.csv). Below is a proposed sequence focused on the security milestone you flagged. Please confirm or push back on dates.

Proposed MAP security milestone (draft):
- Milestone: Security review & evidence delivery
  - Owner (Redwood): Monica Patel (Security Program Lead) — provide evidence index + control mappings
  - Owner (FinnovA): FinnovA Security inbox (security@finnova.com) / Elena Ruiz — intake and acceptance
  - Deliverables: Completed questionnaire, evidence index CSV with links, SOC 2 report excerpts (if available), architecture diagram, log retention policy
  - Target due date (initial): 2027-05-18
  - Dependencies: NDA/BAA signed (if required), access to sample logs (read-only), confirmation of controls in scope
  - Acceptance criteria: FinnovA security signs off on evidence package or submits clarifying questions within 3 business days

Next steps I propose:
1) Monica to fill the evidence-index template with initial owners and dates (by 2027-05-04).
2) Redwood sends completed questionnaire answers + evidence links (by 2027-05-11).
3) Security review complete / acceptance or Qs by FinnovA (by 2027-05-18).

If that timeline looks tight, we can shift to a June 1 acceptance target but it would push onboarding out. Ben — want to add anything on procurement support or PO cadence?

Thanks,

—Michael Grant
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx; evidence-index-template.csv
Related link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/finnova-map-draft

Thanks Michael — that sequencing is helpful. A couple clarifications from our security lead:  

- Please address whether evidence will be delivered as: a) shared cloud storage links (preferred), b) on-prem dropbox, or c) signed bundle via secure transfer. We prefer shared links with RBAC.
- For items that require access to logs or live KV caches, we'll need a read-only access plan and an expiration date.
- We already have an NDA in place; a BAA may be required for production data — procurement (Carlos) will confirm.

I've added our security inbox (security@finnova.com) for intake. Monica — could you include a quick note in your delivery that flags anything that will need engineering assistance beyond the standard evidence artifacts?

Also — for the MAP: can you include a single column for 'evidence effort' (low/med/high) so we can prioritize? That will help us accept in phases if needed.

Elena
